faq.q: How do credits work on a holiday ad?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. If it fails, those credits return.

faq.q: Can I add holiday music and pictures?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a track from the music library, choose visuals that fit the season, and add captions in the editor. Use music you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I make holiday ads for many products?
faq.a: Yes. Run several product links and each one comes back as its own ad. You still review every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar deliver the holiday message?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar can stand beside the product and say the line, with the product kept large enough to recognize.

faq.q: What happens to the ad after the holiday?
faq.a: You keep the file. Change the offer line, the voice, or the caption and use the same scene for the next sale day.

faq.q: How early should I prepare the holiday creative?
faq.a: Before the offer is final. Get the avatar and the line ready from the product link, then type the discount when it is set.

faq.q: Can the ad start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Open the listing that will go on sale and use its photo as the scene. If that photo cuts the product off, upload the full shot.

faq.q: Can I publish the holiday video to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file when it looks right, or send it to the feed you already use. It stays in your account until you share it.

faq.q: Do I need a separate file for each placement?
faq.a: Yes. Make a separate video for each placement: tall, square, wide, 4:3, or 3:4.

faq.q: Can I put an end time on the sale ad?
faq.a: Yes. Set it in the editor and move it later if you need to. It stays off the product picture, so a new deadline can keep the same scene.

faq.q: Can my store tools start a holiday ad from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. A connected store tool can request a holiday ad from a product link. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.
